top_signals.title: Goldman Says Tech Bull Market Has Room to Run
top_signals.summary: Goldman Sachs Wealth Management’s Matt Weir says the recent concentration of market gains among a handful of large technology stocks doesn’t signal the end of the bull market. He expects hyperscaler capital-spending growth to decelerate from its extraordinary pace but remain well above overall economic growth, and argues that earnings will ultimately determine where stocks go next. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: U.S. Gasoline Prices Set October Record Even as National Average Slips
top_signals.summary: U.S. gasoline prices have fallen for a second straight week, but drivers are still paying more at the pump than they ever have in October. AAA put the national average at $4.36 per gallon Thursday, down about five cents from a week ago. A year ago, gasoline averaged $3.12. This is the first October in which the national average has remained above $4 per gallon. The drop came despite a small increase in gasoline demand. EIA data showed demand rising to 8.76 million barrels per day from 8.68 million bpd, while gasoline inventories edged up to 204.7…
